sourceEvidence.title: Global Technology Guardian - CMPT
sourceEvidence.quote: The GTG role is meant to serve as the brain trust of the manufacturing technology used in the mechanical converting operations. This role will be responsible for defining the Most Effective Technology (MET) and owns the multi-year technology roadmap for the Conversions operations. The GTG also sets the vision for future manufacturing technology including Automation of Process Equipment and next-gen process technologies. Globally, there are 15-20 MT and Run Plant Engineers who support Conversions modules across our sites. This role leads that network of Engineers globally and guides their activities on various improvement and development projects including Quality, Site-matching, MET Leveraging, Basic Data and execution of new Capital projects, etc.
